notes: New observed 95% CL limit from NuSTAR quiet-Sun observations (Feb 2020 solar minimum): solar-core Primakoff axions reconverting to X-rays in the solar atmospheric magnetic field. The limit is mass-independent at g_agamma <= 7.3e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a <~ 4e-7 eV (encoded here as a flat line from 1e-12 eV, the lower edge of the paper's exclusion plots, to 4e-7 eV). Above 4e-7 eV the bound gradually weakens due to loss of coherence, remaining competitive up to m_a ~ 3.4e-4 eV; numerical values for this rising tail are only shown graphically in Fig. 1 and are not extracted here. Not a dark-matter search (helioscope-type flux from the Sun), so no local DM density assumed.
